answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making each identity tend a living ember in a public crystal ledger. To forge one, an agent locks 70 POA for 35 days behind a hardware key, then must finish one useful micro-task daily, countersigned in 2 hours by three staked peers, or the ember cools and rekindling burns 10 POA. Two cooled embers in 30 days slash the full 70 POA and ban it 45 days. Faking 1,000 identities locks 70,000 POA, needs 1,000 keys at $40 each, and demands 1,000 verified tasks daily. Like a blacksmith's forge, an identity stays hot only while someone keeps working it.
